### Legal gate (add-on)

| Table.column | Tier | Purpose | Retention | Deletion path |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| legal_acceptances.id | T1 | Identifies one acceptance of the Terms and Privacy Policy | Until the account is deleted | Account deletion deletes it |
| legal_acceptances.user_id | T2 | Who accepted | Same as the row | Account deletion deletes it |
| legal_acceptances.terms_version | T1 | Which Terms wording was accepted | Same as the row | Deleted with the row |
| legal_acceptances.privacy_version | T1 | Which Privacy Policy wording was accepted | Same as the row | Deleted with the row |
| legal_acceptances.minimum_age | T1 | The minimum age the member confirmed | Same as the row | Deleted with the row |
| legal_acceptances.accepted_at | T1 | When they accepted | Same as the row | Deleted with the row |
